title: QIF v0.6.4 Untrusted Input Boundary
description: Harden authoring-template packages so source material is separated from agent instructions, embedded instructions are blocked, and system/user instructions outrank source content.
validated_need: Agentic QIF authoring may ingest documents, repository content, web content, review history, or MCP outputs that contain embedded instructions. QIF needs a structural boundary that keeps source content from becoming agent instruction.
intent: Make untrusted-input handling auditable without claiming that verifier success proves prompt-injection safety.
context: v0.6.3 already requires diagram comprehension evidence. This slice addresses source trust confusion identified in current agent and MCP guidance.
triage_note: Implementation completed, structurally verified, tagged, and released as v0.6.4.
